scoring_justification: Agent computes Cp values from phonon DOS; checker compares each to paper-reported computed values digitized from Fig. 6 using relative error with monotonic tolerance scoring.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold computed Cp values of andalusite at 300 K, 500 K, 1000 K, 1500 K from the paper's shell model, digitized from Fig. 6.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Fig. 6 of the paper: Rao et al., Solid State Communications 121 (2002) 333-338.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized using WebPlotDigitizer from the computed Cp line in Fig. 6; values are also consistent with the reference solver hardcoded constants.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the paper's own computed specific heat results, serving as the authoritative gold for reproducing this computational task.

outputs.description: Computed specific heat at constant pressure at 300 K, 500 K, 1000 K, and 1500 K. The checker compares these values against hidden experimental gold values digitized from Fig. 6 of the paper, awarding full credit if the absolute relative error ≤ 5% with linear decay to 0 at 10% error.

output_contract.notes: Only the specific heat is scored; intermediate artifacts (structure, phonon DOS, elastic/thermal) are evidence of process execution but not directly scored.
